toc.title: Fidei Mosis Amyraldi, circa errores Arminianorum declaratio.
Eiusdem Amyraldi, de natura & efficacitate misericordiæ interuentu diuinæ prouidentiæ patefactæ, sententia.
De æqualitate & inæqualitate gratiæ, eiusdem Amyraldi sententia.
De phrasi, homines possunt credere, si velint.
De impotentia physica & morali: deque iis quæ ἐφ᾽ ἡμῖν esse dicuntur.

book: A single Latin polemical treatise by Moïse Amyraut (Amyraldus), printed 1646: a title page, then the Declaratio on the author's doctrine of grace, which opens with a defence of Calvin and then has four titled sections on named topics.
